mapper.select: select d.day_id, d.trip_id, d.day_no, t.start_date + d.day_no - 1 as day_date, (select count(*) from schedule s where s.day_id = d.day_id) as schedule_count, p.place_names from trip_day d join trip t on t.trip_id = d.trip_id left join (select day_id, listagg(place_name, ', ') within group (order by rn) as place_names from (select s.day_id, s.place_name, row_number() over (partition by s.day_id order by s.slot_no, s.sch_id) as rn from schedule s where s.place_name is not null) where rn <= 3 group by day_id) p on p.day_id = d.day_id where d.trip_id = #{tripId} and t.del_yn = 'N' order by d.day_no
